thread.title: Insanity: Loudoun County Opens Title IX Investigation into Boys Who Expressed Concern Over 'Male Identifying' Biological Female Using Boy's Locker Room and Recording Reactions-Governor Youngkin Responds | The Gateway Pundit | by Margaret Flavin
thread.title_full: Insanity: Loudoun County Opens Title IX Investigation into Boys Who Expressed Concern Over 'Male Identifying' Biological Female Using Boy's Locker Room and Recording Reactions-Governor Youngkin Responds | The Gateway Pundit | by Margaret Flavin

author: Lulu
text:
The father of one of the boys LCPS is investigating spokeat a School Board meeting and urged a change in the policy that allows students to use locker rooms and bathrooms based on what sex they identify with. It sounds like Gov. Younkin already overruled the schools' imposition of this insanity:
Two years ago, my administration issued model policies that (1) unless federal law requires otherwise, require students to use the locker room corresponding to their sex, If people were thrown in jail and business lost rights to operate when violating an arbitrary executive order during COVID, there should be some basic consequences for LCPS and its administration for ignoring the governor now. The hypocrisy never ceases to amaze me.
